posts.title: From Cloud-First to AI-First: Productivity-Maxxing or Token-Maxxing?
posts.description: Imagine a company in 2016. An engineer is standing in a meeting room, trying to convince the CTO and CIO to move an application to the cloud. The engineer has prepared a demo, a cost estimate, and answers to the questions that came up in the previous meeting. There have been several previous meetings.

posts.title: The Third Reset: Becoming a Developer Advocate in the AI Era
posts.description: Someone asked me recently what advice I’d give to a person trying to break into DevRel in the AI era. I gave an answer around “something something AI”. But then it bothered me -.- so this blog is me answering that question, again.

posts.title: DevRel Is Not Measured Like Other Roles — And That Needs to Change
posts.description: Over the past year, I’ve had a recurring conversations with developer advocates at different companies, different stages, different products. The details change. The frustration doesn’t. They feel like they’re being evaluated by a rulebook that was written for a different role entirely.
